title: Kettlebell Swing
summary: A two-hand hip-hinge swing for powerful hip extension and conditioning. It's good for the glutes and hamstrings, but more for power than for size.

setup.text: Stand with the bell slightly in front, hinge and grip it with both hands.
Hike it back between your legs, then snap your hips forward to float it to chest height.
Let it swing back and hinge into the next rep.

form_cues.cue: Hike the bell back between your legs
Let the bell float to chest height
It's a hinge, not a squat. Drive with your hips, not your arms.

mistakes.text: Squatting the swing instead of hinging.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds up to 2 ramp-up sets only when the load is heavy for the equipment and the main muscle is not warm yet.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 7.5% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 8-12 reps, stopping about 3 reps short of failure (RIR 3). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Pick a variation and range you can train pain-free.
